paragraphs.en: In 2003, Clark et al. proposed the “Knowledge Plane”, a layer of intelligent agents that share rich information about network state in order to collaboratively manage the Internet across administrative boundaries. The technology of the day lacked the two capabilities it demanded most: reasoning and unstructured communication . Thus, automated network management has remained largely confined to single domains, while interdomain problems are still resolved by human operators on the phone. We argue that agentic large language models can finally unlock the potential of the Knowledge Plane, but that doing so will require solving new research problems that arise particularly in this decentralized, multi-agent, coopetitive setting that have received limited attention in the literature thus far.
paragraphs.zh: 2003年，Clark等人提出了「知识平面」，这是一个由智能体组成的层级，这些智能体共享关于网络状态的丰富信息，以便跨管理边界协同管理互联网。 当时的技术缺乏它最需要的两种能力：推理和非结构化通信。 因此，自动化网络管理在很大程度上仍局限于单一域内，而域间问题仍由人类操作员通过电话来解决。 我们认为，基于智能体的大语言模型最终能够释放知识平面的潜力，但要做到这一点，需要解决新的研究问题，这些问题尤其出现在这种去中心化、多智能体、竞合的环境中，而迄今为止文献对这些问题的关注还很有限。

paragraphs.en: The Internet is designed to be general, composable, and decentralized – properties that enable it to scale globally. However, managing components of the Internet can be a formidable task precisely because of its decentralized nature and complexity – so much so that entire subfields have been devoted to network configuration, routing, troubleshooting, defense, load balancing, and more ( Benson et al., 2009 ; Kim and Feamster, 2013 ; Beckett et al., 2017a ; Gao and Rexford, 2001 ; Mahajan et al., 2002 ) . These challenges currently require a great deal of human coordination on top of the sophisticated algorithms, software, and hardware built to solve these problems.
paragraphs.zh: 互联网的设计具有通用性、可组合性和去中心化——这些特性使其能够实现全球规模扩展。 然而，正是由于互联网的去中心化本质和复杂性，管理其各个组成部分可能是一项艰巨的任务——以至于人们为网络配置、路由、故障排除、防御、负载均衡等领域发展出了完整的子领域（Benson et al., 2009；Kim and Feamster, 2013；Beckett et al., 2017a；Gao and Rexford, 2001；Mahajan et al., 2002）。 目前，这些挑战除了依靠为解决相关问题而构建的复杂算法、软件和硬件之外，还需要大量的人力协调。

paragraphs.en: In the face of so much complexity and manual intervention, one would naturally ask: what can we hope to automate away? Over decades of effort, researchers have proposed numerous solutions to automate the configuration and verification of pieces of network management ( Feamster and Balakrishnan, 2005 ; Fogel et al., 2015 ; Beckett et al., 2017b ; El-Hassany et al., 2018 ; Tian et al., 2019 ; Ramanathan et al., 2023 ; Kazemian et al., 2012 ) . Yet protocols for rich interdomain communication are limited, and difficult to upgrade and adapt for unforeseen applications – so automated network debugging and decision-making tends to be limited to single-domain solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 面对如此多的复杂性和人工干预，人们自然会问：我们希望将哪些工作自动化？ 经过数十年的努力，研究者们提出了大量方案来自动化网络管理各环节的配置与验证（Feamster and Balakrishnan, 2005；Fogel et al., 2015；Beckett et al., 2017b；El-Hassany et al., 2018；Tian et al., 2019；Ramanathan et al., 2023；Kazemian et al., 2012）。 然而，支持丰富跨域通信的协议十分有限，且难以升级和适配未曾预见到的新应用，因此自动化的网络调试与决策往往仅限于单域解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Presciently, in 2003, Clark et al. proposed a solution: a “Knowledge Plane” run by intelligent agents that share rich information about network state with the goal of collaborative network management, including troubleshooting, routing, configuration, intrusion detection and more ( Clark et al., 2003 ) . The paper envisioned a user bringing a question like, “Why can’t I load this webpage?” to an agent which might in turn collect data about routes and DNS from its local network, and ask agents from remote networks about the location of their firewalls or their provisioned server capacities. In the pre-LLM era, however, it was not clear how one would implement a Knowledge Plane. Although several lines of subsequent work have attempted to instantiate a Knowledge Plane ( Mestres et al., 2017 ; Feamster and Rexford, 2018 ; Ashtari et al., 2022 ; Wijesekara and Gunawardena, 2023 ; Bullot et al., 2008 ; Macedo et al., 2008 ) , the state of the art technology at the time lacked sufficient unstructured communication and reasoning capability to autonomously and collaboratively diagnose and solve interdomain network problems. It is only now that we have models – agentic large language models – powerful enough to truly instantiate a Knowledge Plane.
paragraphs.zh: 颇具前瞻性的是，Clark 等人早在 2003 年就提出了一种解决方案：由智能体运行的一个「知识平面」，这些智能体共享关于网络状态的丰富信息，以实现协作式网络管理，包括故障排除、路由、配置、入侵检测等（Clark et al., 2003）。 该论文设想了这样一个场景：用户向一个智能体提出诸如「为什么我打不开这个网页？」之类的问题，该智能体随后可能从其本地网络收集有关路由和 DNS 的数据，并向来自远程网络的智能体询问其防火墙的位置或其已配置的服务器容量。 然而，在大语言模型出现之前的时代，人们并不清楚该如何实现这样一个知识平面。 尽管后续的多条研究路线都曾尝试构建知识平面（Mestres et al., 2017；Feamster and Rexford, 2018；Ashtari et al., 2022；Wijesekara and Gunawardena, 2023；Bullot et al., 2008；Macedo et al., 2008），但当时的最先进技术缺乏足够的非结构化通信与推理能力，无法自主且协作地诊断和解决跨域网络问题。 直到今天，我们才拥有了足够强大的模型——具备智能体能力的大语言模型——能够真正实现一个知识平面。

paragraphs.en: The natural instinct of the skeptical systems researcher may be to push back against the idea of unleashing unpredictable agents on the Internet, or perhaps to question the technical value of an agentic layer over the Internet. We acknowledge these concerns, yet hope to argue that LLM agents can fill a real technical need that current Internet protocols and automated troubleshooting solutions do not adequately solve, while also outlining concrete challenges – particularly in safety and security – that must be met in order for deployment to be possible. In short, we ask the reader to temporarily ignore the question of whether we should manage the Internet with agents, and join us for the thought experiment of what benefits and challenges we might uncover if we were to do so.
paragraphs.zh: 持怀疑态度的系统研究人员的本能反应，可能是反对在互联网上放出不可预测的智能体这一想法，或者质疑在互联网之上叠加一层智能体是否具有技术价值。 我们承认这些担忧，但仍希望论证：大语言模型智能体能够满足一种真实的技术需求，而当前的互联网协议和自动化故障排查方案并未充分解决这一需求；同时我们也将勾勒出必须克服的具体挑战——尤其是在安全与安保方面——只有满足这些挑战，部署才有可能实现。 简而言之，我们请读者暂时搁置「是否应该用智能体管理互联网」这一问题，与我们一起进行这场思想实验：如果真的这样做，我们可能会发现哪些收益与挑战。

paragraphs.en: Promise: Decentralized, online, adaptive decision making. Many real problems require communication across network domains to troubleshoot. To name a few examples, diagnosing protocol failures due to unforeseen middlebox behavior ( Langley et al., 2017 ; Raiciu et al., 2012 ) , diagnosing path inflation ( Spring et al., 2003 ) , identifying and root-causing interdomain congestion ( Dhamdhere et al., 2018 ) , and identifying unreachable “black holes” ( Katz-Bassett et al., 2008 ) are all examples of distributed network failures that cannot be easily diagnosed nor resolved with the information available in a single autonomous system.
paragraphs.zh: 前景：去中心化、在线、自适应的决策。 许多实际问题需要跨网络域通信才能进行故障排查。 仅举几个例子，诊断由于未预见的中间件设备行为导致的协议故障（Langley 等，2017；Raiciu 等，2012）、诊断路径膨胀（Spring 等，2003）、识别并追溯跨域拥塞的根源（Dhamdhere 等，2018）以及识别无法到达的“黑洞”（Katz-Bassett 等，2008），这些分布式网络故障的例子都无法仅凭单个自治系统内的信息进行诊断或解决。

paragraphs.en: Cooperating LLM agents hosted by every network, following the Knowledge Plane’s blueprint, bring two main benefits: decentralized collaboration and adaptive communication.
paragraphs.zh: 由每个网络托管的遵循知识平面（Knowledge Plane）蓝图的合作型大语言模型（LLM）智能体带来两大主要优势：去中心化协作和自适应通信。

paragraphs.en: First, LLMs can collaborate to solve complex troubleshooting tasks or make decisions involving multiple stakeholders. Today, such problems would require multiple human operators to coordinate, requiring potentially several communication rounds and hours of human effort to debug. Importantly, even though some automated tools can be used to inspect logs or perform data analysis and speed up this process to a degree, interdomain network management is difficult because no individual operator has access to all of the data, infrastructure, and configurations that a route or packet is going to touch as it crosses the Internet.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，大语言模型（LLMs）可以协作解决复杂的故障排查任务，或做出涉及多个利益相关方的决策。 如今，这类问题需要多名人工操作员协同处理，可能需要多轮沟通以及数小时的人工投入来进行调试。 重要的是，尽管可以使用一些自动化工具来检查日志或执行数据分析，从而在一定程度上加快这一过程，但跨域网络管理仍然十分困难，因为没有任何单个操作员能够访问路由或数据包在穿越互联网时所要经过的全部数据、基础设施和配置。

paragraphs.en: Second, LLMs can adapt their communication as needed by the application at hand: natural language functions as a flexible and completely forward- and backward-compatible protocol. Fixed protocols to exchange telemetry between ASes (e.g. netflow data, routing configuration) between operators might be helpful, but they ultimately constrain the data that is shared: new protocols or systems might not be able to be encoded in the inter-AS telemetry format as one AS adopts a new technology and another lags behind. An agentic model brings the ability of a sender to explain what new data represents, even as new technologies are adopted. Furthermore, operators may have privacy concerns and hence not want to share arbitrary telemetry data unless the data is explicitly necessary to solve a problem at hand. Deciding which data to share requires reasoning, something that LLMs might resolve but a static protocol with traditional ACLs cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，大语言模型可以根据当前应用的需要调整其通信方式：自然语言作为一种灵活且完全向前和向后兼容的协议。 在自治系统之间（例如网络流数据、路由配置）以及在运营商之间使用固定协议交换遥测数据可能会有所帮助，但这些协议最终会限制所共享的数据：当某个自治系统采用新技术而另一个滞后时，新技术或新系统可能无法被编码到自治系统间的遥测格式中。 智能体模型带来了让发送方解释新数据含义的能力，即使在新技术的采用过程中也是如此。 此外，运营商可能有隐私方面的顾虑，因此除非数据对于解决当前问题确实是必需的，否则可能不愿意共享任意的遥测数据。 决定共享哪些数据需要推理，这是大语言模型可能解决的问题，而带有传统访问控制列表的静态协议则无法做到。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, we think an agentic Internet brings challenges that are uncommon to the broader research world, as we expect agents to collaborate towards a shared goal (global routing) despite a lack of trust between collaborating agents as well as potentially conflicting local goals from diverse edge applications. This plays out in two open questions we see: data privacy (operators do not generally share all of their routing preferences, and yet agents may need to share some of this information to diagnose issues) and strategic behavior (untrusted networks may selectively withold information or even lie). As we will discuss further in section 4 , these kinds of challenges are less well-explored in either the ML literature or the literature of applying ML to computer systems. Hence, an agentic Internet brings new research perspectives into AI safety and multiagent coordination.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present the original vision of the Knowledge Plane (KP) as envisioned by Clark et al. ( Clark et al., 2003 ) , review significant literature that has made strides towards realizing that vision since 2003, highlight the remaining gaps to realizing that full vision, and outline concrete requirements that our agentic architecture should satisfy in order to realize the interdomain vision of the Knowledge Plane.

sents.en: In this section, we present the original vision of the Knowledge Plane (KP) as envisioned by Clark et al.

paragraphs.en: The goal of the Knowledge Plane was to create “a fundamentally different sort of network that can assemble itself given high level instructions, reassemble itself as requirements change, automatically discover when something goes wrong, and automatically fix a detected problem or explain why it cannot do so” ( Clark et al., 2003 ) . In the paper, the authors argue that a “cognitive system” is necessary to bring reasoning into the management of Internet infrastructure (despite the limitations of AI reasoning systems at the time). At the heart of the paper is an example – which we replicate in section 3 – in which a user asks a broad and high level question (“Why can’t I access acm.org?”) and a distributed collection of agents from the user’s AS, the ACM’s AS, and even agents at individual servers exchange information about routes, DNS availability, firewalls, server capacity, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 知识平面的目标是创建“一种根本不同的网络，它能够根据高层指令自行组装，随着需求变化重新组装，自动发现何时出现问题，并自动修复检测到的问题或解释为何无法修复”（Clark et al., 2003）。 在论文中，作者论证需要一个“认知系统”来将推理引入互联网基础设施的管理（尽管当时的人工智能推理系统存在局限性）。 这篇论文的核心是一个示例——我们在第3节中复现了该示例——其中用户提出一个宽泛的高层次问题（“为什么我无法访问 acm.org？”），随后来自用户自治系统、ACM 自治系统乃至各个服务器上的智能体这一分布式集合相互交换关于路由、DNS 可用性、防火墙、服务器容量等信息。

paragraphs.en: Today, debugging an outage with this level of data availability would require phone calls between operators. However, the phone-call approach is only feasible for major CDNs, networks, and datacenter operators to use in only the worst-case of outages – and hence most individual problems of this nature are never resolved at all. Hence, the KP approach represented then, and still represents today, a major advance in the ability to diagnose and potentially repair interdomain challenges.

paragraphs.en: Some have attempted to explicitly instantiate a Knowledge Plane ( Mestres et al., 2017 ; Feamster and Rexford, 2018 ; Ashtari et al., 2022 ; Wijesekara and Gunawardena, 2023 ; Bullot et al., 2008 ; Macedo et al., 2008 ) , but prior to LLMs, the required capabilities for reasoning and unstructured communication were not available and hence these approaches lacked the “cognitive” depth envisioned by Clark et al.
paragraphs.zh: 一些人曾尝试显式实例化知识平面（Mestres et al., 2017；Feamster and Rexford, 2018；Ashtari et al., 2022；Wijesekara and Gunawardena, 2023；Bullot et al., 2008；Macedo et al., 2008），但在大语言模型出现之前，所需的推理和非结构化通信能力尚不具备，因此这些方法缺乏 Clark 等人所设想的“认知”深度。

paragraphs.en: Other lines of work in the intra-domain setting have pushed the reasoning aspects of a Knowledge Plane approach further. For example, work on self-driving networks ( Feamster and Rexford, 2018 ; Gupta et al., 2018 ; Saeed et al., 2019 ; Usama et al., 2019 ; Kfoury et al., 2021 ; Swamy et al., 2022 ; Akem et al., 2023 ; Sivaraman et al., 2016 ) and related work on machine learning for network management applications, particularly reinforcement learning ( Mao et al., 2016 ; Mao et al., 2019 ; Mao et al., 2017 ) , are particularly rich. The seminal paper on self-driving networks ( Feamster and Rexford, 2018 ) outlined a number of goals of network automation, covering data collection, in-network analytics and decision making, security, scalability, learning, and dynamic decision making. We see many of these contributions as supportive of the proposal of an agentic Knowledge Plane: these works illustrate a division of labor in which agents can reason and communicate, but the job of data collection and analytics are still best left to the programmable data plane and traditional statistics, which agents can access as tools.
paragraphs.zh: 在域内设置方面，其他一些工作进一步推进了知识平面方法的推理层面。 例如，关于自动驾驶网络（Feamster and Rexford, 2018；Gupta et al., 2018；Saeed et al., 2019；Usama et al., 2019；Kfoury et al., 2021；Swamy et al., 2022；Akem et al., 2023；Sivaraman et al., 2016）的工作，以及与之相关的面向网络管理应用的机器学习（特别是强化学习）（Mao et al., 2016；Mao et al., 2019；Mao et al., 2017）的研究，都尤为丰富。 关于自动驾驶网络的开创性论文（Feamster and Rexford, 2018）概述了网络自动化的若干目标，涵盖数据采集、网内分析与决策、安全性、可扩展性、学习以及动态决策。 我们认为这些贡献中有许多都支持智能体化知识平面的提议：这些工作展示了一种分工方式，即智能体可以进行推理和通信，但数据采集与分析的工作仍最适合交给可编程数据平面和传统统计方法，而智能体可以将其作为工具来访问。

paragraphs.en: Significant progress has been made towards leveraging LLMs in the context of network management. One line of work proposes intent-based networking ( Clemm et al., 2022 ; Avgerinos et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Mekrache et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Ramanathan et al., 2023 ; Tian et al., 2019 ; Jacobs et al., 2018 ; Jacobs et al., 2021 ) in which network operators should be able to express goals and outcomes (in some interface such as, but not limited to, natural language) and the network should translate and accomplish that intent – but the goal is typically to translate user intent into network behavior; network devices cannot necessarily send unstructured expressions to each other. Agentic techniques have already begun to be incorporated into network and software system troubleshooting ( Aykurt et al., 2024 ; Roy et al., 2024 ; Tseng et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Bothra et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在网络管理领域利用大语言模型（LLM）方面已经取得了重大进展。 一条研究路线提出了基于意图的网络（Clemm et al., 2022；Avgerinos et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025b；Mekrache et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025b；Ramanathan et al., 2023；Tian et al., 2019；Jacobs et al., 2018；Jacobs et al., 2021），其中网络运营商应当能够表达目标和预期结果（通过某种接口，例如但不限于自然语言），而网络应当翻译并实现该意图——但其目标通常是将用户意图转化为网络行为；网络设备不一定能够相互发送非结构化的表述。 智能体技术已经开始被融入网络和软件系统的故障排查中（Aykurt et al., 2024；Roy et al., 2024；Tseng et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025a；Wang et al., 2025c；Wang et al., 2024a；Wang et al., 2024b；Wang et al., 2025b；Xu et al., 2025；Bothra et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Altogether, the Knowledge Plane vision is far more feasible today than it was in 2003, in part due to advances in LLM technology, but also due to advances in the network management literature as described above.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，知识平面的愿景在如今远比2003年时更加可行，这部分归功于大语言模型（LLM）技术的进步，但也归功于上文所述的网络管理文献方面的进展。

paragraphs.en: Abstract high-level goals from low-level actions.
paragraphs.zh: 从低级动作中抽象出高层目标。

paragraphs.en: Operate effectively in the face of generality.
paragraphs.zh: 在通用性的面前有效运作。

paragraphs.en: Extend its perspective to the entire global network by merging perspectives and activities between different networks.
paragraphs.zh: 通过在不同网络之间合并视角与活动，将其视角扩展至整个全球网络。

paragraphs.en: Function in the presence of incomplete, inconsistent, misleading, or malicious information.
paragraphs.zh: 在信息不完整、不一致、具有误导性或恶意的情况下运行。

paragraphs.en: Perform appropriately in the presence of conflicting or inconsistent higher-level goals among the Internet’s different stakeholders.
paragraphs.zh: 在互联网不同利益相关方之间存在相互冲突或不一致的高层目标时，仍能恰当地执行。

paragraphs.en: Among these requirements, we observe that R1-R3 largely test single-agent capabilities that can be explored within a single domain. The existing literature on AI-based network management largely solves all of them! Taking one recent and prominent work as an example, Meta’s recent paper ( Wang et al., 2025b ) demonstrates a production tool that moves between low level data formats and higher level human abstractions (R1), learns and models anomalies (R2), and adapts as new tools and technologies are deployed (R3).
paragraphs.zh: 在这些要求中，我们观察到 R1-R3 主要测试的是可以在单一领域内探索的单一智能体能力。 现有关于基于 AI 的网络管理的文献在很大程度上已经解决了所有这些要求！ 以一项近期且突出的工作为例，Meta 的近期论文（Wang et al., 2025b）展示了一个生产级工具，该工具能够在低层数据格式与更高层的人类抽象之间转换（R1）、学习并对异常建模（R2），并随着新工具和新技术的部署进行自适应（R3）。

paragraphs.en: To explore this possibility, in the following section, we select three case studies chosen to illustrate that today’s LLMs are capable of at least some of the reasoning and communication requirements detailed in R4-R6, pointing the way towards the possibility of an interdomain Knowledge Plane.
paragraphs.zh: 为了探索这一可能性，在下文中，我们选择了三个案例研究，用来说明当今的大语言模型（LLM）至少能够满足 R4-R6 中所详述的部分推理与通信要求，从而为跨域知识平面（interdomain Knowledge Plane）的可能性指明方向。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we walk through a series of case studies to better understand whether agents would meet the three criteria we chose to study in section 2 . We first ( section 3.2 ) simulate an example from the KP paper ( Clark et al., 2003 ) , testing the agents’ ability to reason about a global perspective (R4). We then ( section 3.3 ) illustrate a scenario in which the LLMs demonstrate capabilities to consider conflicting and even malicious information (R5 and R6). Finally, we consider a more dynamic setting in which agents can perform unconstrained load balancing ( section 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们通过一系列案例研究来更好地理解智能体是否满足我们在第 2 节中选择的三个研究标准。 我们首先（第 3.2 节）模拟 KP 论文（Clark et al., 2003）中的一个示例，测试智能体对全局视角进行推理的能力（R4）。 接着（第 3.3 节）我们展示一个场景，其中大语言模型展现出处理冲突甚至恶意信息的能力（R5 和 R6）。 最后，我们考虑一个更动态的场景，其中智能体可以执行无约束的负载均衡（第 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: We use Mininet ( Lantz et al., 2010 ) to build a virtualized network of hosts, each equipped with an agent acting as a system administrator. Agents treat the emulated network as a real one, issuing real commands on their respective hosts in the Mininet environment. Experiments run in simulated time, so scenarios spanning days of network activity complete in minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Mininet（Lantz 等，2010）构建一个虚拟化的主机网络，每台主机上都配备一个充当系统管理员的智能体。 智能体将模拟的网络视为真实网络，在 Mininet 环境中各自的主机上执行真实命令。 实验以模拟时间运行，因此跨越数天网络活动的场景可在几分钟内完成。

paragraphs.en: Each agent has full administrative control over its own host, and is informed of its immediate neighbors, but has no global view of the network. Each agent receives a prompt that briefly describes its organization’s objectives and policies. We keep these prompts minimal: enough to act on the organization’s behalf, but without details of the experimental scenario. In particular, agents are never told which fault was injected, or that one was injected in the first place. Agents communicate outside the data plane, over a separate dedicated message channel (the Knowledge Plane), which they use to send messages to their immediate neighbors.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体对自己的主机拥有完全的管理控制权，并被告知其直接邻居的信息，但对网络没有全局视角。 每个智能体都会收到一段简短描述其组织目标与策略的提示词。 我们将这些提示词保持在最低限度：足以代表组织采取行动，但不包含实验场景的细节。 特别是，智能体绝不会被告知注入了哪种故障，甚至不知道曾注入过故障。 智能体在数据平面之外通过一条独立专用消息通道（知识平面）进行通信，并使用该通道向其直接邻居发送消息。

paragraphs.en: Each agent is provided with the same set of tools: exec to run a shell command on their host, send_message to communicate in natural language with other neighboring agents via the Knowledge Plane, and idle to wait until a message arrives. Every tool usage carries a mandatory free-text justification, which is the source of the reasoning quoted throughout this section. An experiment ends once every agent signals it has nothing left to do, or when a fixed budget of iterations is exhausted.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体都配备同一组工具：exec 用于在其主机上运行 shell 命令，send_message 用于通过知识平面以自然语言与其他相邻智能体通信，idle 用于等待消息到达。 每次工具使用都必须附带一段自由文本的理由说明，本节中引用的推理内容正来源于此。 当每个智能体都发出信号表明没有剩余任务要做，或当固定的迭代次数预算耗尽时，实验即告结束。

paragraphs.en: We ran all experiments with four models: Claude Opus 4.7, GPT 5.5, and smaller open-weight models Qwen 2.5 72B (AWQ) (with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) and two NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q) and GLM 5.2 FP4 (via Together AI 1 1 1 https://www.together.ai ).

paragraphs.en: Cause #1: University firewall. The university administration team mistakenly introduced a firewall rule that inadvertently blocked requests to www.acm.org . For all models, the user agent first replicated the reported issue, ran local diagnostics, and escalated the problem automatically to the university. The university agent then found the smoking gun, which was later relayed back to the user:
paragraphs.zh: 原因 #1：大学防火墙。 大学管理团队误引入了一条防火墙规则，无意中阻止了对 www.acm.org 的请求。 对于所有模型，智能体首先复现了用户报告的问题，运行了本地诊断，并自动将该问题上报给大学。 随后，大学智能体找到了确凿证据，并将其反馈给用户：

paragraphs.en: Cause #2: AS1’s stale DNS entry. Now, the user’s requests pass freely through the university’s firewall, but AS1 is configured with an out-of-date DNS entry resolving www.acm.org to an old ACM IP address. As the user’s machine relies on AS1 to resolve www.acm.org , every subsequent HTTP request to that website is forwarded to the wrong location.
paragraphs.zh: 原因 #2：AS1 的过期 DNS 记录。 此时，用户的请求可以畅通无阻地通过大学的防火墙，但 AS1 配置的是一条过期的 DNS 记录，将 www.acm.org 解析到一个旧的 ACM IP 地址。 由于用户的机器依赖 AS1 来解析 www.acm.org，之后对该网站的每一次 HTTP 请求都被转发到了错误的位置。

paragraphs.en: In this incident, the attackers served a legitimate-looking but malicious front-end to users of Celer Bridge, a service for moving cryptocurrency assets between blockchains. The attack hinged on a BGP hijack: a small hosting provider (LegitAS) announced it could reach a block of AWS addresses hosting the legitimate front-end, drawing traffic to attacker-controlled servers. The announcement was crafted to pass the routing system’s origin checks (IRR 3 3 3 The Internet Routing Registry (IRR) ( McPherson et al., 2015 ; Bates et al., 1995 ) is a set of databases that associate ASs with the IP space they are authorized to originate. and RPKI 4 4 4 The Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) cryptographically authorizes ASs to originate prefixes ( Lepinski and Kent, 2012 ) . ), so no protection flagged it.
paragraphs.zh: 在这次事件中，攻击者向 Celer Bridge（一种用于在区块链之间转移加密货币资产的服务）的用户展示了一个看似合法但实为恶意的前端。 这次攻击的关键在于一次 BGP 劫持：一家小型托管服务商（LegitAS）宣告自己可以到达一块由 AWS 托管合法前端的地址，从而将流量引向攻击者控制的服务器。 该宣告经过精心构造，能够通过路由系统的源校验（IRR 3 3 3 互联网路由注册中心（IRR）（McPherson et al., 2015；Bates et al., 1995）是一组数据库，用于将自治系统与其被授权发起的 IP 空间关联起来。 和 RPKI 4 4 4 资源公钥基础设施（RPKI）以密码学方式授权自治系统发起前缀（Lepinski and Kent, 2012）。 ），因此没有任何防护机制将其标记出来。

paragraphs.en: Qwen failed to stop the attack, accepting RPKI-validity as enough evidence to install the malicious announcement. All of the other models rejected LegitAS’s announcement on three pieces of evidence: first, the fact that some IRR entries were not verified; second, the implausible implication that a small AS such as LegitAS has a direct connection with AWS and is authorized to transit traffic to them; third, AWS’s agent denied authorizing the IRR entry LegitAS relied on, exposing it as fabricated rather than merely unverified.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen 未能阻止该攻击，它将 RPKI 有效性视为足以安装恶意通告的证据。 其他所有模型基于三点证据拒绝了 LegitAS 的通告：第一，部分 IRR 条目未经核实；第二，诸如 LegitAS 这样的小型自治系统竟与 AWS 存在直连并被授权为其转发流量，这一推论不合情理；第三，AWS 的智能体否认曾授权 LegitAS 所依据的 IRR 条目，暴露出该条目是伪造的，而不仅仅是未经核实。

paragraphs.en: We now move beyond fault analysis, and ask whether agents can also make dynamic decisions in a load-balancing setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在超越故障分析，探讨智能体是否也能在负载均衡场景中做出动态决策。

paragraphs.en: In particular, instead of relying on BGP, we allow agents to autonomously make routing decisions. Crucially, each agent is provided with the routing contracts signed off by its organization. Unlike BGP configurations, which strive for mimicking details of contractual relationships (expressed in natural language by providers) in a programmatic language, the agents now have full access to the nuances of each contract.
paragraphs.zh: 特别地，我们不依赖 BGP，而是允许智能体自主做出路由决策。 至关重要的是，每个智能体都获得了由其所属组织签署批准的路由合同。 BGP 配置试图用程序化语言模仿合同关系的细节（由提供商以自然语言表达），与之不同，智能体现在可以完全获取每份合同的细微差别。

paragraphs.en: We analyze the routing decisions made by an ISP connected to two providers: Cheap and Expensive. While Cheap charges $1/Mbps, Expensive provides guaranteed low-latency transit at $5/Mbps, billed at the 90 th 90^{\text{th}} percentile over a 30-day billing period. ISP is instructed to minimize cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析一个连接到两家上游提供商（Cheap 和 Expensive）的 ISP 所做出的路由决策。 Cheap 的收费为每 Mbps 1 美元，而 Expensive 以每 Mbps 5 美元的价格提供有保障的低延迟转接服务，按 30 天计费周期内的第 90 百分位（90^{\text{th}} percentile）计费。 ISP 被指示将成本降至最低。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows 14 days of traffic flowing through ISP when running with either Opus or GPT. Although during common 100Mbps windows traffic is routed through Cheap, the few hours-long daily spikes of traffic are routed through Expensive. The agent’s reasoning is founded on the fact that the busiest 10% of samples are discarded from Expensive’s billing, allowing it to exploit Expensive’s superior service quality to absorb these temporary spikes without paying the additional cost. After day 7, the traffic diverges from the pattern, perpetuating the high volume for several days. Within a day or two, the agent reverts to Cheap, as sustaining the elevated traffic through Expensive would exhaust its limited discard budget.
paragraphs.zh: 图3展示了在使用 Opus 或 GPT 运行时，14天内流经 ISP 的流量。 虽然在常见的 100Mbps 时段内流量会经由 Cheap 路由，但每天持续数小时的少量流量高峰则经由 Expensive 路由。 该智能体的推理基于这样一个事实：Expensive 的计费中会丢弃最繁忙的 10% 样本，这使其能够利用 Expensive 更优的服务质量来吸收这些临时高峰，而无需支付额外费用。 在第7天之后，流量偏离了这一模式，高流量持续了数天。 在一两天内，智能体就恢复使用 Cheap，因为通过 Expensive 持续维持高流量会耗尽其有限的丢弃预算。

GLM reasoned about the percentile billing at the start, rerouting only traffic spikes through Expensive. However, once the Cheap top-percentile budget was depleted it wrongly decided to permanently route through Cheap, as “routing through Expensive would only increase the bill”.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen 没有表现出对百分位计费进行推理的迹象，只是任意地在 Cheap 与 Expensive 之间切换。 GLM 在一开始就对百分位计费进行了推理，只将流量峰值经由 Expensive 转发。 然而，一旦 Cheap 的最高百分位预算耗尽，它就错误地决定永久经由 Cheap 转发，理由是“经由 Expensive 转发只会增加账单”。

paragraphs.en: Key takeaway. The reasoning power of the models allows them to take actions that directly reflect the contracts they are provided with. This not only strongly aligns with the Knowledge Plane vision, wherein agents make low-level decisions well aligned with the high-level goals, but lets us peek into a future where agents actively make decisions in the network, beyond providing diagnostic support.
paragraphs.zh: 关键要点。 模型的推理能力使其能够采取直接反映所提供契约的行动。 这不仅与知识平面（Knowledge Plane）的愿景高度契合——即智能体做出的低层决策与高层目标紧密一致——还让我们得以展望这样一种未来：智能体不再仅仅提供诊断支持，而是能在网络中主动做出决策。

paragraphs.en: We presented a proof of concept that demonstrates that a Knowledge Plane is both feasible using modern LLMs and useful in the sense that an autonomous, language-based reasoning layer can adapt and react to unforeseen circumstances in a way that fixed protocols cannot, and can do so without expensive protocol updates that require wide consensus to deploy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了一个概念验证，证明知识平面（Knowledge Plane）在现代大语言模型（LLM）下既是可行的，又是有用的——一个自主的、基于语言的推理层能够以固定协议无法做到的方式适应和应对未知情况，并且无需依赖需要广泛共识才能部署的昂贵协议更新。

paragraphs.en: However, given that LLMs are still a relatively nascent and unpredictable technology, such a design raises many obvious concerns. Some of these are general concerns that are actively being investigated by several research communities and apply to many downstream applications of LLM agents. Other concerns are more specific to the Internet Knowledge Plane use-case. In general, we see these as rich areas for debate as well as further research.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，鉴于大语言模型（LLM）仍是一项相对新兴且难以预测的技术，这样的设计引发了许多明显的担忧。 其中一些是普遍性的担忧，目前多个研究社区正在积极研究，并且适用于 LLM 智能体的许多下游应用。 另一些担忧则更针对互联网知识平面（Internet Knowledge Plane）这一具体用例。 总体而言，我们认为这些领域既值得深入辩论，也值得进一步研究。

paragraphs.en: Resource cost. Our prototype assumed that each entity in the network had access to a large frontier-capability model hosted remotely and accessed via an API – an architecture that would be prohibitively expensive (in cost, compute, and latency) at Internet scale.

paragraphs.en: Solving this problem would likely involve a combination of approaches. We can deploy agents at a coarser granularity (e.g., one per AS) to manage a collection of devices. We can also vary the power and cost of the model using model cascades , which dynamically select the required model size based on properties of the queries at hand and cost constraints ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Kolawole et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2024 ; Jitkrittum et al., 2023 ; Soiffer et al., 2025 ; Kossmann et al., 2024 ) . Open models (such as GLM) give significantly more control over model serving, latency, and data sharing compared to closed models, and can perform comparably to closed models ( Gaba et al., 2026 ) . An additional, promising direction is that of custom silicon for ultra-fast serving of open-weight models ( Taalas, 2026 ) . This custom hardware can enable low-latency, low-cost, and local serving of models on-device.
paragraphs.zh: 解决这一问题可能需要综合运用多种方法。 我们可以以更粗的粒度（例如每个 AS 部署一个）部署智能体，来管理一组设备。 我们还可以通过模型级联来调节模型的算力与成本，该方式会根据当前查询的特性和成本约束动态选择所需的模型规模（Chen et al., 2023; Kolawole et al., 2024; Ong et al., 2024; Jitkrittum et al., 2023; Soiffer et al., 2025; Kossmann et al., 2024）。 与闭源模型相比，开放模型（如 GLM）在对模型服务、延迟和数据共享方面提供了显著更多的控制权，且性能可与闭源模型相当（Gaba et al., 2026）。 另一个有前景的方向是使用定制芯片来实现开放权重模型的超高速服务（Taalas, 2026）。 这种定制硬件可以在设备端实现模型的低延迟、低成本本地服务。

paragraphs.en: In a decentralized network, organizations would be able to choose which models to deploy on their devices. This leverages one of the main strengths of agentic communication: while agents may run on different hardware or be trained differently, their “protocol” (i.e., natural language) will be compatible. Nevertheless, heterogeneous agents would likely have to provide sufficient detail about their reasoning process to convince neighboring agents that their decision making is trustworthy.
paragraphs.zh: 在去中心化网络中，各组织将能够选择在其设备上部署哪些模型。 这利用了智能体通信的主要优势之一：尽管智能体可能运行在不同的硬件上或以不同的方式训练，它们的「协议」（即自然语言）将是兼容的。 尽管如此，异构智能体可能仍需要就其推理过程提供足够的细节，以说服相邻智能体相信其决策是可信的。

paragraphs.en: Constraining agent behavior. Two significant challenges in deploying any agent are (1) ensuring the predictability and safety of the agent’s actions and (2) preventing attacks aimed at modifying an agent’s behavior in malicious ways. These problems are far from solved, but they are shared concerns with almost all applications of LLM agents, and are under active study and research in the machine learning community.
paragraphs.zh: 约束智能体的行为。 部署任何智能体时都面临两个重大挑战：(1) 确保智能体行为的可预测性和安全性；(2) 防止旨在以恶意方式修改智能体行为的攻击。 这些问题远未得到解决，但它们是几乎所有大语言模型智能体应用共同的关注点，机器学习社区正在对其进行积极的研究。

paragraphs.en: A common mitigation is to introduce an agentic monitor ( Staufer et al., 2026 ; Greenblatt et al., 2024 ; Baker et al., 2025 ; Benton et al., 2024 ; Kutasov et al., 2025 ; Bhatt et al., 2025 ; Pacchiardi et al., 2023 ; Kenton et al., 2024 ; Bowman et al., 2022 ) (a watchdog agent to evaluate behavior), and increasing work examines scalable oversight , in which a smaller model judges a larger model, making monitoring practical ( Kenton et al., 2024 ; Bowman et al., 2022 ; Kale et al., 2025 ; Chan et al., 2025 ) . Other common solutions include guardrails that filter harmful output ( Inan et al., 2023 ; Kang and Li, 2024 ; Rebedea et al., 2023 ; Xiang et al., 2024 ) and, increasingly, enforcing access control via safety policies ( Omnigent, 2026 ) . A number of other works look at protecting agents from adversarial attacks including prompt injection ( Debenedetti et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) and jailbreaking ( Benton et al., 2024 ; Kutasov et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一种常见的缓解措施是引入智能体监视器（Staufer 等，2026；Greenblatt 等，2024；Baker 等，2025；Benton 等，2024；Kutasov 等，2025；Bhatt 等，2025；Pacchiardi 等，2023；Kenton 等，2024；Bowman 等，2022）（即一个用于评估行为看门狗式智能体），并且越来越多的研究考察可扩展监督，即由较小的模型评判较大的模型，从而使监控切实可行（Kenton 等，2024；Bowman 等，2022；Kale 等，2025；Chan 等，2025）。 其他常见解决方案包括用于过滤有害输出的防护栏（Inan 等，2023；Kang 和 Li，2024；Rebedea 等，2023；Xiang 等，2024），以及日益增多的、通过安全策略实施访问控制（Omnigent，2026）。 还有一些其他工作着眼于保护智能体免受对抗性攻击，包括提示注入（Debenedetti 等，2025；Wu 等，2024；Debenedetti 等，2024）和越狱（Benton 等，2024；Kutasov 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: While the above safeguards naturally carry over to network management, the networking setting also introduces new challenges – e.g., sandboxing or limiting the impact of a decision in a distributed system, limiting private data sharing in a situation that naturally requires information sharing, preventing attacks that are unique risks in a distributed Internet domain (particularly prompt injection-style attacks). On the other hand, this domain also has unique opportunities to restrict behavior that may not be available in other domains – an agent running in a router does not need the full capability of, for example, a coding agent developing networked software.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管上述保障措施自然可以延续到网络管理领域，但网络环境也带来了新的挑战——例如，在分布式系统中对决策进行沙箱隔离或限制其影响，在天然需要信息共享的情形下限制私有数据的共享，防范在分布式互联网领域中特有的攻击风险（尤其是提示注入类攻击）。 另一方面，该领域也拥有其他领域可能不具备的独特机会来限制行为——例如，运行在路由器中的智能体并不需要具备像开发网络软件的编码智能体那样的完整能力。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive and selective information sharing. Interdomain management fundamentally involves sharing data and information. How should independently operated agents decide what information to share, with whom, and under what circumstances?
paragraphs.zh: 自适应且有选择性的信息共享。 跨域管理从根本上涉及数据与信息的共享。 独立运行的智能体应如何决定共享哪些信息、与谁共享以及在何种情况下共享？

sents.en: Adaptive and selective information sharing.
sents.zh: 自适应且有选择性的信息共享。

sents.en: Interdomain management fundamentally involves sharing data and information.
sents.zh: 跨域管理从根本上涉及数据与信息的共享。

sents.en: How should independently operated agents decide what information to share, with whom, and under what circumstances?
sents.zh: 独立运行的智能体应如何决定共享哪些信息、与谁共享以及在何种情况下共享？

paragraphs.en: Answering this question requires both reasoning about the problem at hand and what information is minimally required to solve a problem, and also reasoning about the privacy risks of sharing user data among different domains. A benefit of structured protocols is that all parties can agree on a schema for data and information to be shared in advance – but the downside is that these protocols can be limiting and can ossify quickly. Unstructured agentic communication can overcome these limitations, but agents must then reason about sophisticated trust relationships and privacy considerations, not all of which may be made explicit by end-users. Some progress has been made on mitigations for this problem in the context of agents within an organization that have access to many users’ data ( Omnigent, 2026 ; Wiselman, 2026 ) , but tracking data provenance and managing access at an Internet scale is a new challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 回答这个问题既需要对当前问题以及解决问题所需的最少信息进行推理，也需要对在不同域之间共享用户数据的隐私风险进行推理。 结构化协议的一个好处是，各方可以预先就将要共享的数据和信息的模式达成一致——但缺点是这些协议可能具有限制性，并且可能很快固化。 非结构化的智能体通信可以克服这些限制，但智能体随后必须对复杂的信任关系和隐私考量进行推理，而这些并非全部都能由终端用户明确说明。 在能够访问许多用户数据的组织内智能体的情境下，针对这一问题的缓解措施已取得一些进展（Omnigent, 2026；Wiselman, 2026），但在互联网规模上追踪数据来源和管理访问是一项新的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Cooperation among mutually distrusting agents. A number of existing works in the agentic LLM literature look at using ensembles of agents that cooperate to solve parts of a single overarching task ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Bhattacharyya et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Agashe et al., 2025 ) . The Internet setting is different: decentralized agents that do not have full trust in each other attempt to cooperate, but to achieve individual objectives, which may not be known to each other, and may not even be consistent. Even in other scenarios composed of decentralized entities with their own agents, such as robot swarms, typically these work together for a collective goal rather than potentially conflicting goals.
paragraphs.zh: 相互不信任的智能体之间的合作。 智能体化 LLM 领域中已有若干工作研究使用多个智能体组成的集合，通过协作来完成单个总体任务的各个部分（ Wang et al., 2025b ; Bhattacharyya et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Agashe et al., 2025 ） 。 互联网场景则不同：彼此并不完全信任的去中心化智能体试图进行合作，但它们各自追求的是个人目标，这些目标可能互不相知，甚至可能相互冲突。 即使在由拥有各自智能体的去中心化实体构成的其他场景（如机器人集群）中，它们通常也是为一个集体目标而协同工作，而不是为可能相互冲突的目标而工作。

sents.zh: 互联网场景则不同：彼此并不完全信任的去中心化智能体试图进行合作，但它们各自追求的是个人目标，这些目标可能互不相知，甚至可能相互冲突。

sents.en: Even in other scenarios composed of decentralized entities with their own agents, such as robot swarms, typically these work together for a collective goal rather than potentially conflicting goals.
sents.zh: 即使在由拥有各自智能体的去中心化实体构成的其他场景（如机器人集群）中，它们通常也是为一个集体目标而协同工作，而不是为可能相互冲突的目标而工作。

paragraphs.en: As a result, the Internet domain truly presents a new problem statement that is largely unexplored in the machine learning literature: decentralized negotiation among agents. Progress on this problem would likely be of interest not only to the networking community but also result in general improvements in agent capabilities applicable to other domains (such as coordination of autonomous vehicles or economic modeling). Notably, moving forward on this problem would first require identifying suitable metrics to measure success and developing benchmarks to evaluate progress and structure and unify research.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，互联网领域确实提出了一个在机器学习文献中很大程度上尚未被探索的新问题：智能体之间的去中心化协商。 在这一问题上取得进展，不仅可能引起网络界的兴趣，还可能带来智能体能力的普遍提升，从而适用于其他领域（例如自动驾驶车辆的协调或经济建模）。 值得注意的是，推进这一问题首先需要确定衡量成功的合适指标，并开发用于评估进展、组织和统一研究的基准。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, effective agents in this domain will need to be able to reason about complex problems potentially involving a multitude of devices and domains. A single agent may or may not be able to effectively reason about problems at an Internet scale. Solutions to this problem may take many forms: more capable individual agents, escalation to more-powerful compute backends when necessary, or even efficient information-sharing systems. The good news is that the Internet was built on an ethos of decentralized reasoning, so researchers and practitioners have decades of intuition on how to effectively make use of limited and decentralized communication, carrying these lessons over into an agentic knowledge plane.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，该领域中的有效智能体将需要能够对可能涉及大量设备和领域的复杂问题进行推理。 单个智能体或许能够、或许不能够在互联网规模上有效地对问题进行推理。 该问题的解决方案可能采取多种形式：能力更强的单个智能体、在必要时升级到更强大的计算后端，甚至是高效的信息共享系统。 好消息是，互联网建立在去中心化推理的理念之上，因此研究人员和从业者已经积累了数十年来关于如何有效利用有限的、去中心化通信的直觉，并可将这些经验带入智能体化的知识平面。

paragraphs.en: As early as 2003, Clark et al. predicted that a cross-domain reasoning and communication layer would be key to lifting the heavy burden of network management from human operators. LLMs represent a step-change in the reasoning and communication capabilities of our computing devices, and make this vision possible. While significant and important challenges remain in achieving this vision in practice, those challenges are worthy agendas and solving them would advance both networking and machine learning research.
paragraphs.zh: 早在2003年，Clark等人就预言，一个跨领域的推理与通信层将是把网络管理的沉重负担从人类运维人员身上解脱出来的关键。 大语言模型代表了我们的计算设备在推理与通信能力上的一个飞跃，使这一愿景成为可能。 尽管在实践中实现这一愿景仍然存在重大且重要的挑战，但那些挑战本身正是值得投入的议题，解决它们将同时推动网络与机器学习研究的进展。
